svg.aria-label: Telegram: a Russian channel post arrives, the bot translates it, and it appears in the English twin channel
svg.text: EVERY RUSSIAN CHANNEL GETS AN ENGLISH TWIN

g.text: A new version of the notes app…
Five quiet places to rest by…
bot is translating a new post…
Up to 16 degrees on Saturday, light wind,
a few clouds on Sunday afternoon.
Five quiet places to rest by the sea
Small bays, a lighthouse café and a forest path
that ends at a hidden beach.
Tram 3 will run more often at weekends
From November, trams will come every 8 minutes
The new riverside park opens on Saturday
The opening starts at 11:00 with a concert by the
city orchestra and free guided walks.
Traffic on Shkolnaya Street will be closed until mid-November
Repair work starts on Wednesday and will last about
12 days. Buses on route 31 will take a detour.
